research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Verofax Limited is researching systems and methods for personalized retail with smart glasses, enabling buyers to view product information and make purchases through visual augmentation technology. Additionally, they are developing solutions for detecting purchased or tampered containers, allowing tracking of a product’s container state using cameras. These areas of research focus on enhancing traceability for products, stakeholders, and transactions.

product.name: AI Employees
product.description: AI-powered customer-service and sales agents deployed across web, mobile, phone, email, WhatsApp, and onsite channels to answer questions, automate workflows, and support customers 24/7.

product.name: Computer Vision Traceability
product.description: AI and computer-vision software for product verification, serialization, digital audits, compliance monitoring, and traceability across products, operations, stakeholders, and transactions.

product.name: AI + AR Solutions
product.description: Augmented-reality and AI experiences for wayfinding, product discovery, gamified engagement, personalized assistance, tourism, and visitor analytics in physical locations.

product.name: AI-Powered Holobox
product.description: An onsite AI avatar platform that provides multilingual customer assistance, recommendations, wayfinding, lead capture, and interactive experiences through a physical holographic display.

product.name: Interactive Product Digitization and Packaging
product.description: A product-digitization service that assigns digital identities and web-linked experiences to physical products for direct consumer engagement, promotions, traceability, and first-party data collection.
